map.债务保障倍数(DSCR)计算器，输入经营现金流与年度债务偿付额，按 DSCR=经: The debt service coverage ratio (DSCR) calculator takes operating cash flow and annual debt service and computes DSCR = operating cash flow / debt service to assess repayment ability, for loan credit assessment.
map.输入经营现金流与年度债务偿付额，求 DSCR。: Enter operating cash flow and annual debt service to get DSCR.
map.银行贷款审批的核心指标，DSCR≥1.2~1.5 才易获授信。: A core metric in bank loan approval; DSCR≥1.2~1.5 is usually needed for approval.
map.项目融资或发债时，向投资人证明还本付息能力。: Prove repayment ability to investors when financing a project or issuing bonds.
map.企业自身监控，DSCR 下滑时提前安排再融资或缩减开支。: For the company's own monitoring — arrange refinancing or cut spending early when DSCR falls.
map.计算偿债保障倍数: Compute the debt service coverage ratio
map.：某公司年度经营现金流 600 万元，当年本金+利息偿付额 400 万元，DSC: : a company with annual operating cash flow of 6 million CNY against 4 million CNY of principal plus interest has DSCR=600/400=1.5, i.e. cash flow covers debt service 1.5 times — a reasonable safety margin.
map.DSCR 小于 1 意味着什么？: What does a DSCR below 1 mean?
map.DSCR<1 表示经营现金流不足以覆盖当期债务本息，需动用现金储备或再融资，长期: DSCR<1 means operating cash flow cannot cover current principal and interest, so cash reserves must be drawn down or refinancing arranged; sustained, this faces default risk.
map.分子为什么用经营现金流而非净利润？: Why does the numerator use operating cash flow rather than net income?
map.经营现金流是真实可用来还债的现金，净利润含折旧等非付现项目且可被应计项目操纵；用: Operating cash flow is genuinely available cash for repaying debt, while net income includes non-cash items such as depreciation and can be manipulated by accruals — so cash flow is more robust.
